The initiative

From an idea to something useful.

I founded SafeFlow Vietnam to connect water-safety education, introductory STEM learning, and practical support for communities affected by water risk. I led two field programs in Y Tý, Lào Cai, a highland community exposed to recurring flash floods and landslides, and Suối Tượng, Đồng Nai, where families live in floating homes and daily life is closely tied to the water.

2Field programs
~200Students & residents served
>VND 50mAid & programming
01

Learn from the setting

Each location shaped the program: Suối Tượng highlighted everyday life on the water, while Y Tý brought attention to the recurring risks of flash floods and landslides.

02

Teach and support

Activities combined water-safety education, hands-on STEM introductions, and the distribution of safety equipment and school supplies.

03

Mobilize resources

The two programs served approximately 200 students and residents, with more than VND 50 million mobilized in aid and programming.

Why Suối Tượng

Suối Tượng · Learning in a floating community

Suối Tượng is a waterside community where families live in floating homes. This close connection to boats and the water made it a meaningful setting for SafeFlow’s work. The program paired water-safety learning with model assembly, classroom demonstrations, and a model-boat test at the water’s edge.

Why Y Tý

Y Tý · Learning for a more prepared community

Y Tý is a mountainous commune in northern Vietnam near the Chinese border, where heavy rains bring recurring risks of flash floods and landslides. SafeFlow chose this location because water-safety awareness and practical problem-solving are especially relevant to the community. At the local school, the program combined hands-on STEM learning, safety education, and practical support for students.

In pictures

Further details

Program reach

Led two field programs serving approximately 200 students and residents in Y Tý, Lào Cai, and Suối Tượng floating village, Đồng Nai, with more than VND 50 million mobilized in aid and programming.

Delivery scope

SafeFlow delivered water-safety education and introductory STEM activities, distributed safety equipment and school supplies, and connected rescue-drone and smart-life-jacket concepts with needs identified in flood-prone communities.
